sources.entry: IconGenerator - macOS app to generate app icons.

summary.one_liner: An Electron desktop app for macOS that turns one source image into app icon sets for iOS, iPad, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS, plus .icns files.
summary.what_it_does: The app takes a dropped image (png, jpeg, jpg, webp, tiff, gif, or svg) and resizes it with sharp. It generates an AppIcon.appiconset folder for iPhone, iPad, macOS, tvOS, or watchOS, following the iOS Human Interface Guidelines, and generates from the latest Xcode Contents.json. It can also output an AppIcon.icns file. Results are saved to the Downloads folder.
use_cases: Generate iOS app icon sets from one image
Make watchOS or tvOS app icons for Xcode
Resize a logo into all Xcode asset catalog sizes
Prepare app icons for an App Store submission
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the repository's releases page
Drag an image onto the left box
Choose a platform: iPhone, iPad, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, or icns file
Find the generated AppIcon.appiconset or AppIcon.icns in the Downloads folder
notable: Generates Xcode AppIcon.appiconset folders matching the latest Contents.json format
Accepts png, jpeg, jpg, webp, tiff, gif, and svg inputs
caveats: README describes support for macOS only
Install instructions are a download link to releases; no build steps are given
README is brief and has some missing link text
